profile.headline: Software Engineer, Python Developer, 8 years
profile.summary: Software engineer looking for a position where I can continue to grow my 8 years of hands-on experience working. A strong background in Computer Science has provided me the ability to quickly adapt to any environment to solve the business needs of clients. Experienced with filling a client-facing role, and am effective at bridging the gap between technology & business. Particularly experienced with utilizing Python in backend development, as well as utilizing AWS and Azure consistently through my professional experience.

positions.title: Technical Implementation Engineer
positions.description:
• Member of an agile team that provides solutions based on needs not provided by the form application platform itself, such as third party integrations (Salesforce, etc.) or automating application reviews.
 • Architectural design and development of multiple reoccurring jobs that intake form data from users to provide feedback based on criteria from the client (ex. Grant eligibility, mail automation, etc.)
 • Lead developer and point person on multiple successful projects leading to securing clients.
 • Contributor and user of the internal python package library developed to utilize the platforms REST API for mass data intake and manipulation.
 • Oversaw the deployment of each solution via individual docker images in a company managed Azure Kubernetes cluster through the use of Github actions and GHCR. Monitoring done via ArgoCD.
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · Git · Python (Programming Language) · docker · Kubernetes · FastAPI · Optical Character Recognition (OCR) · SQL · Technical Solution Design · Technical Solution Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Member of an agile team that provides robust applications centered around mass data analysis and artificial intelligence (AI) based on predictive analysis utilizing Azure infrastructue.
• Development of multiple predictive AI models that return confidence scores and resultant data based on input (ex. Income -> debt resolution percentage)
• Both architectural design and development of multiple AI applications that intake images of physical documents and return parsed relevant data (ex. Insurance Patient data)
• Backend REST API contributions to full stack web applications primarily around linking provided information to existing predictive AI models.
• Development and implementation of various reporting tools (incl. Azure Insights) for diagnostic purposes of the models and applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Databases · Pandas (Software) · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Optical Character Recognition (OCR) · Scikit-Learn · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Microsoft Azure · SQL

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Member of an agile team that provides modern solutions for both legacy hardware and software related to playing Bridge.
• Python backend microservice engine contributions to how games submitted by members are processed in a uniform way despite differing methods / formats from third party software / sources.
• VueJS / Laravel Frontend contributions to how submitted games are then displayed varying from results to extra provided analytical information.
• Python / PHP scripting development of various internal jobs to solidify the integrity of our data, process notifications for our members, as well as provide necessary features for both internal business needs and users.
• Development of a C#/.NET tournament seeding application based on our large internal data library from the AS400.
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · Git · Python (Programming Language) · PHP · C# · .NET Framework · Vue.js · Laravel · Microservices · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Lead of a six person Support Team that aids customers with technical issues such as advising on general services and practices, troubleshooting their code / web pages, Etc. 
• Main technical resource for high priority customers integrating with service, ex. code for their framework, API examples, network configuration, etc.
• Responsible for the integration of new employees, overseeing the training of ten new hires in the span of 3 months
• Responsible for the administration and maintenance of 350+ Windows virtual machines across various internal servers by utilizing developed internal Python scripts
• Handle deployment of necessary software and OS configurations across Windows through the development of automated Python script executables
• Provide technical documentation of frameworks in various languages for customers, as well as github repository examples
positions.insights: Skills: Databases · VMware Infrastructure · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Selenium
